sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 44 = check 43; Internal Quality Checks row 44 annotation: 'Gate/constraint failures hard-zero the quality terms, and passing only the cheap gates earns little.')
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/task/tests/scored/polish/judge.toml and scored/visual/judge.toml (parsed: [judge] keys, aggregation, criterion types and weights)
evidence: Policy: task/tests/scoring.toml:1-3 has [gates] render = 0.0 and constraints = 0.0; :5-8 weights functional 0.6 / polish 0.2 / visual 0.2 (sum 1.0, gates absent from [weights]); :10-11 [floors] functional = 0.05. scoring.toml, test.sh and tools/score.py are byte-identical to the frozen template copies (cmp; sha256 95f70d6e..., bd682592..., 13de2b38...). Gates before shaping: test.sh:212-215 removes any scored log and runs the gates suite first; :216-222 runs score.py and on exit 1 does 'exit 0' before the scored suite at :224 is ever launched, any other non-zero status writes the plain zero. score.py:41 gates_passed requires every gate score > 0.0; :42-44 forces every weighted dimension to 0.0 unless gates passed; :46 the weighted sum iterates only [weights], so gates contribute no mass; :47-48 reward is 0.0 unless gates and the functional floor (strictly > 0.05) both pass; :83 returns 1 on gate failure. Gate judge.toml files use aggregation = "all_pass" with binary criteria only (render 1 criterion, constraints 2), no weight/model key in [judge], so a gate score is 0 or 1. Executed check (this review, frozen score.py against synthetic reward.json inputs in a scratch directory): gate fail with scored 1/1/1 present -> exit 1, reward 0.0, functional/polish/visual reported 0.0; functional exactly 0.05 with polish 1 and visual 1 -> floors_passed 0, reward 0.0 (weighted_score 0.43 not paid); functional 0.0 with polish 1/visual 1 -> reward 0.0; gates passed with no scored record -> reward 0.0; all 1.0 -> reward 1.0. Floor in task terms: functional has 38 binary criteria with weight sum 54.0 (minimum weight 1.0), so the floor needs more than 2.7 weight units: one criterion (max 2.0/54 = 0.037) or 1.0+1.5 (0.046) still yields reward 0, so polish/visual cannot be farmed by an app that passes the gates and at most one or two cheap functional criteria. Broken-app probes: blank page or static mock fails gates/render (typed program must compute and re-compute a sum) -> zero and scored skipped; a textarea/CodeMirror app fails gates/constraints cw_custom_document_surface -> zero even with perfect styling; a polished shell that passes all three gates but no functional criterion -> floor zeroes it. Conforming alternative: the gate criteria name no route, framework or colour, and a hidden input used only for key events is explicitly allowed, so I found no conforming app that this row's mechanics would zero. Residual, recorded not waived: the gate-fail skip in test.sh and the configured rewardkit all_pass aggregation were verified by source reading and by running score.py only; raw-evidence-index.json states it is scripted golden evidence and not a configured judge/verifier run, so no end-to-end verifier log shows the scored suite being skipped. That missing runtime evidence is why risk is true. Policy observation outside this row's remedy (template-controlled): just above the floor (3.0/54) with perfect polish and visual the reward is 0.4343, of which 0.40 is non-functional; that is the shipped 0.6/0.2/0.2 template policy and belongs to rows 39/44, not a defect of this task's gate wiring.
